editorial:
Imagine a bunch of scary aliens deciding to wipe out humanity, but instead of sending a genius spy, they send the biggest idiot in the galaxy. That is exactly what you get here. You will follow this clueless alien who tries to blend in with humans, but he fails at almost everything. The vibe is totally wild and chaotic, feeling more like a funny cartoon from the old days than a serious space movie. It does not take itself seriously at all, which makes the whole experience a lot of fun if you just want to turn your brain off and laugh at some weird stuff.

What really pops is the animation style and the fast pacing that keeps you from getting bored. While the humor is a bit random and might not be for everyone, the sheer energy is great. If you enjoy weird, offbeat comedies, you should definitely give this a shot. You can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp look, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: In the end, the moron alien completely fails his mission to gather intelligence. Because he is so clueless, he accidentally causes a huge mess that makes the other aliens realize humans are not even worth the effort to destroy. The movie wraps up with the aliens giving up on Earth entirely. It is a funny twist because the world is saved not by a hero, but by an alien who was just too dumb to do his job.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves adult animation and random humor.
